name: consultant-onboarding
description: First-run AgentOS setup. Walk the consultant through owner profile, first client, scheduling preferences. Mark complete once memory/owner.md and at least one memory/clients/<slug>/ exist.

title: Capture owner profile (memory/owner.md)
description: Ask the consultant: name, city, languages, working hours, current client count, top 3 priorities for the month, deep-work hours. Save to memory/owner.md following the template structure.

title: Add first client
description: Pick the consultant's most active / urgent client. Capture: name, address, owner contact, brand voice (sample of their writing), engagement scope. Save to memory/clients/<slug>/index.md from _template.md. Create an Epic in saga-mcp named client-<slug>.

title: Set monitoring preferences
description: For each client, ask the consultant whether to enable scheduled scans (review-monitor, competitor-sweep weekly). Set monitoring: enabled|disabled in their ops.md. Default disabled — don't surveil without consent.

title: Confirm daily-brief preference
description: Ask: do you want a 09:00 morning brief? If yes, what timezone, what to include (yesterday's pending replies, today's calls, client check-ins). Save to memory/owner.md.
